source_text: Audite reges, percipite satrapae — ego Domino canam. Cantus ecclesiae reges terrae docet. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Hear kings, perceive satraps — I to-Lord will-sing. Song of-church kings of-earth teaches. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Hear, O kings; give ear, O rulers — I will sing to the Lord >> Bible:Judges 5:3]]. The church’s song teaches earth’s kings. Amen.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
